title: Spex Repository Config
description: Optional config (spex.repo.yaml) at the root of a workspace repository. Lets the repository own the coverage waivers and the pre-existing error baseline that concern it. spex merges it into the workspace config of spex.yaml.

coverage_ignore.description: Coverage requirements to waive for specs, merged with each spec's own `coverage_ignore` and with the `coverage_ignore` of `spex.yaml` and of every other repository's `spex.repo.yaml`. Each entry is a spec's `coverage_ignore` entry plus the `spec_id` it applies to.

ignored_errors.description: Baseline of pre-existing `error`-severity findings to suppress for this repository, merged with the `ignored_errors` of this repository's entry in `spex.yaml`. Files are relative to this repository's root.
